notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.1.9 - Slave: when all 16 master connections are taken, a new master is now refused and every connected master stays connected. In 1.1.8 the new master replaced the quietest connection, so 17 or more masters polling all the time could knock each other off in turn. Masters that stop halfway through a request (5 s) or vanish (power loss, cable pulled; about a minute) still free their slot automatically.
